votes.motion: Council Member Hull, seconded by Council Member Sudbury, moved to approve the minutes of the Magna Metro Township meetings held on March 12, 2024 and March 26, 2024
Council Member Hull, seconded by Council Member Sudbury, moved to set a public hearing to consider the adoption of the proposed FY2025 Magna City Final Budget for June 11, 2024, at 6:00 PM

Council Member Hull, seconded by Council Member Sudbury, moved to set a public hearing to consider increases to elected, appointed, and executive municipal officers for Magna City for June 11, 2024, at 6:00 PM
Council Member Sudbury, seconded by Council Member Hull, moved to set a public hearing to consider adoption of the FY2025 Magna Tentative Budget for May 28, 2024, at 6:00 PM
Council Member Hull, seconded by Council Member Sudbury, moved to set a public hearing to consider adoption of the FY2025 Magna City Municipal Fee Schedule for June 11, 2024, at 6:00 PM

Council Member Sudbury, seconded by Council Member Hull, moved to set a public hearing to receive public comments on the Municipal Energy Sales, and Use Tax, Municipal Telecommunications License Tax, and Property Tax for June 11, 2024, at 6:00 PM
Council Member Sudbury, seconded by Council Member Hull, moved to direct David Brickey to move forward with an RFP to obtain quotes from various dumpster companies
Council Member Hull, seconded by Council Member Sudbury, moved to close the public meeting to discuss pending or reasonably imminent litigation
